facts.activity_file: identifying every energy source for a task

control_failures.control_label: application of positive isolation devices and personal locks

facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop
facts.title: high potential incident - pressure exposure at P-9504

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 4 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on P-9504 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically identifying every energy source for a task. P-9504 (dewatering pumps) is in service for pit dewatering. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 19 December 2024 a high potential incident was recorded on P-9504 at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop during a planned shutdown; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
